language.title: Language
palette.title: Color palette
palette.preview_note: Moving the selection previews the palette
home.empty.title: Let's add some games
home.empty.text: Install games from the Steam Store, or plug in a USB disk with games: they appear here by themselves.
apps.install.title: Install {app}?
apps.install.widevine.later: To play protected videos and music, the console uses Google Widevine, downloaded from Google. You will be asked to accept Google's terms of use for Widevine when you first open {app}.
widevine.first.title: Protected videos and music
widevine.first.text: To play protected videos and music in {app}, the console uses Google Widevine, Google's software for protected content, downloaded from Google. By continuing, you accept Google's terms of use for Widevine. OwneetOS is not responsible for Widevine.
widevine.update.title: Google Widevine was updated
widevine.update.text: To keep playing protected videos and music in {app}, accept Google's terms of use for the new version of Google Widevine. OwneetOS is not responsible for Widevine.
widevine.terms.name: Google's terms of use
error.apps.widevine_consent: Accept Google's terms for Widevine first.
error.widevine.accept: Your answer could not be saved. Try again.
webapp.prep.title: Preparing {app}…
webapp.prep.first: The first time takes a few seconds: the console downloads Google Widevine. {app} opens by itself when it is ready.
error.apps.preparing: An app is getting ready: wait a moment.
widevine.fail.title: Google Widevine could not be downloaded
widevine.fail.text: {app} needs it to play protected videos and music. Check the internet connection and try again.
apps.remove.title: Remove {app}?
apps.remove.text: Your account stays as it is, but if you install it again you will have to sign in again.
apps.ram.title: Install OwneetOS to add apps
apps.ram.text: Without an installation, apps are kept in the PC’s memory, and there is not enough (at least 12 GB is needed). Install OwneetOS on this PC to add them.
apps.disk.title: Not enough space
apps.disk.text: {app} needs about {mb} MB free on the internal disk. Free some space and try again.
apps.fail.title: {app} was not installed
apps.fail.text: Something went wrong during the installation. Try again; if it happens again, restart the console.
toast.app.wait: Wait for the installation to finish
error.apps.remove: The app could not be removed.
how.title: How to add games
how.steam: Steam: open the Steam Store, sign in and install your games.
how.local: DRM-free games: copy them to a USB or internal disk, in a “Games” folder.
library.sort.title: Sort by
library.sort.name: Name
library.empty.favorites.hint: Press Menu on a game and choose “Add to favorites”.
disks.title: Disks
disk.note.readonly: Read only: games cannot be added to this disk.
close.title: Close {title}?
error.resume: The game cannot be shown right now.
error.close: The game could not be closed.
error.apps.game_running: Another game is running: close it first.
error.apps.program_not_found: The game's program was not found.
error.apps.no_session: The console session is not ready yet.
error.apps.unavailable: Games cannot be started right now.
error.apps.invalid: The game's launch settings are not valid.
error.daemon.unavailable: The system service is not running.
sound.unavailable: Sound is not available right now.
appearance.reduce_motion.detail: Turns off zoom and slide animations
language.keyboard.detail: For the on-screen keyboard and a keyboard plugged in
live.text: From the USB stick: nothing is kept when it turns off.
live.install.pc.detail: Games, saves and settings stay, and updates arrive by themselves
system.power.game: The game that is running will be closed.
system.credits.detail: The open-source projects OwneetOS is made of
credits.title: Credits and licences
credits.text: OwneetOS is free software (GPL-3.0-or-later), built on the work of these projects. Thank you!
error.power: The console could not do that right now.
network.unavailable: Network settings are not available right now
network.offline.detail: Choose a Wi-Fi network below, or plug in a network cable.
network.offline.wifi_off: Turn on Wi-Fi, or plug in a network cable.
network.limited: Connected, but the internet does not answer
network.limited.detail: The network may need a sign-in page, or the internet line may be down.
network.wifi.hardware: Turned off by a switch or a key on the computer
error.network: The network could not do that right now.
error.network.invalid_password: A Wi-Fi password has 8 to 63 characters.
error.network.timeout: {ssid} did not answer. Try again closer to the router.
error.network.unsupported_security: This kind of network is not supported yet.
error.bluetooth: Bluetooth could not do that right now.
pad.pair.detail: Bluetooth controllers: Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo and more
pad.no_bluetooth.detail: Controllers with a cable or a wireless adapter work without it.
pad.remove.text: Turn it off to save its battery, or forget it to pair it again from the start.
pad.unplug: Connected by cable: unplug it to remove it.
pad.dongle: Connected by a wireless adapter: turn it off with its own button.
pad.other: Turn it off with its own button, or unplug it.
pair.title: Pair a new controller
pair.searching: Searching… put your controller in pairing mode
pair.failed: {name} did not pair. Put it in pairing mode again.
pair.xbox.how: Turn it on, then hold the pairing button (top, next to the cable port) until the Xbox button flashes fast.
pair.ps.how: Hold the PS button and the Create (or Share) button together until the light bar flashes.
pair.nintendo.how: Hold the small sync button (top, next to the cable port) until the lights move back and forth.
pair.other.how: Look in its manual for "pairing mode", often a long press on a button.
pair.wired: Wired controllers and Xbox wireless adapters need no pairing: just plug them in.
display.unavailable: Display settings are not available right now
display.reduced: The console is running in its reduced mode
display.reduced.detail: This graphics card cannot run the main mode (Vulkan), so the screen and its resolution cannot be changed.
display.screen.detail: The other screens are turned off
display.move.title: Move the console to {screen}?
display.move.text: The new screen may stay black for up to 30 seconds while it turns on. If nothing is confirmed there, the console comes back to this screen by itself.
display.native: The built-in screen always uses its own resolution
display.keep.text: Without an answer, the previous one comes back in {n} s.
error.display: The screen could not do that right now.
error.display.apps_open: Close the game or app first: the picture goes dark for a moment while the console moves.
notices.title: Notifications
notices.empty.detail: Messages about controllers, network and games appear here.
notices.pad.off.detail: Turn it on again, or pair it from Settings.
notices.net.lost.detail: {ssid} is out of reach. Games keep working offline.
quick.title: Quick menu
quick.power.game: Restart and Shut down close the game that is running.
controls.title: Controls and features
controls.guide: Home: from a game back to the home screen, and back to the game
controls.quick: Where there is nothing to go back to: this quick menu (power options, controls)
controls.menu: Options for the selected game or item
controls.game.home: Home screen over a game: Resume or Close game
controls.game.cage: On older graphics cards, hold Home for 2 seconds to close the game
controls.kb.type: In text fields a keyboard types as usual
add.title: Add games
add.steam.detail: Buy new games in Steam’s store: the games you own are already in your library
add.disk: From a USB stick or disk
disk.title: Games on a USB stick or disk
disk.tree.c.games: at the top of the disk
disk.tree.c.game: one folder per game, named after it
disk.step.plug: Plug the disk into the console: the games appear in the Library by themselves.
disk.step.find: The console finds what to start in each folder. If it is not sure, it asks you once.
disk.step.install: Games with an installer are installed by the console, after you accept their licence.
disk.step.win: Games for Windows work too: nothing else to do.
steam.prep.title: Preparing Steam…
steam.prep.text: Steam opens by itself in a moment.
steam.prep.first: The first time takes a few minutes: Steam downloads its files. It opens by itself when it is ready.
steam.install.title: Steam needs the installed system
steam.install.text: In this trial mode from the USB stick, Steam keeps its files in memory, and this PC has less than 12 GB. Install OwneetOS to use Steam.
error.steam.needs_install: Install OwneetOS to use Steam on this PC.
controls.game.steam: Steam and Steam games: Steam's menu. Hold for 1 second to come back to the console
update.title: Updates
update.available: Newer OwneetOS packages on the USB stick:
update.installing: Installing… Do not unplug the USB stick.
update.done: Installed. Restart the console to use them.
update.none: The USB stick has no newer OwneetOS packages.
update.no_stick: Plug in the OWNEETLOG USB stick with the owneet-updates folder.
update.not_tester: Updates from a USB stick are for test PCs only.
update.failed: The update could not be installed.
steam.state.away: On a disk that is not connected
details.away: Connect the “{disk}” disk to play it.
details.away.unnamed: Connect the disk it is installed on to play it.
install.title: Install {title}?
install.text: Steam downloads it. You can keep using the console meanwhile: the download shows here, on the game.
uninstall.title: Uninstall {title}?
uninstall.text: It is removed from this PC. You can install it again whenever you like.
cancelinst.title: Cancel the installation of {title}?
cancelinst.text: What has been downloaded so far is deleted.
steam.notice.title: Before Steam opens
steam.notice.text: On this PC, Steam’s window might show display errors for a moment, such as leftover pieces of earlier pictures. They are harmless and go away when the window closes.
offline.title: No internet connection
offline.install: Installing a game needs the internet. Connect to a network, then try again.
offline.store: The store needs the internet. Connect to a network, then try again.
offline.first: The first time, Steam needs the internet to download its files and to sign you in. Connect to a network, then try again.
notices.steam.ready.detail: It is in the Library: press A on it to play.
eula.title: {title}: licence agreement
eula.text: The first time, Steam asks you to accept the game's licence agreement. Read it on your phone by scanning the code. Then, in Steam's window, press Left and then A to accept: the game starts.
steam.broken.title: {title} does not start
steam.broken.text: This game’s Linux version does not start. Try the version for Windows?
steam.dl.text: Steam is downloading what the game needs: {p}%
steam.close.title: Close Steam?
steam.close.text: Steam's downloads stop until Steam starts again.
steam.return.title: How to come back from Steam
steam.return.text: In Steam, hold Home at any time to come back to the console. If a Steam page keeps loading, hold Home, then close Steam: press Menu on the Steam tile and choose “Close Steam”.
choose.title: Which file starts {title}?
choose.text: The console found several. It remembers your choice; Options can change it.

notices.disk.plugged.detail.one: {n} game found and added to your Library.
notices.disk.plugged.detail.other: {n} games found and added to your Library.

notices.disk.unplugged.detail: Its games come back when you plug it in again.
system.windows.detail: A download of about 650 MB, needed only the first time.
windows.notice.wait: Windows games will be ready as soon as the console is online
windows.off.title: {title} needs a download
windows.off.text: Windows games need a download of about 650 MB, only the first time. Connect the console to the internet: it then gets them ready by itself.
windows.wait.title: Almost ready
windows.wait.text: Windows games are getting ready ({p}%): a download needed only the first time. {title} can start as soon as it is done.
windows.prep.title: Preparing {title}…
windows.prep.first: The first start takes a little longer.
windows.wait.text.install: Windows games are getting ready ({p}%): a download needed only the first time. {title} can be installed as soon as it is done.
installer.ask.title: Install {title}?
installer.ask.text: The console installs it on its own disk (about {size}). By installing you accept the game’s licence.
installer.licence.title: {title}: licence
installer.licence.missing: The console did not find this game’s licence before installing. It is inside the installer, and after installing it is in the game’s folder (usually in “docs”).
installer.space.title: Not enough space for {title}
installer.space.text: {title} needs about {size} on the console’s disk, and {free} are free. Uninstall a game you no longer play to make room.
installer.unusable.title: {title} cannot be installed yet
installer.unusable.galaxy: This is an online installer: it needs the internet and GOG Galaxy. From your GOG account, download the game’s “offline backup” installer and put it in this folder instead.
installer.unusable.unknown: The console does not know this kind of installer yet.
installer.stop.title: Stop installing {title}?
installer.stop.text: What is installed so far is removed. You can install it again later.
installer.uninstall.title: Uninstall {title}?
installer.uninstall.text: It is removed from the console’s disk ({size} freed). Its installer stays on {disk}: you can install it again.
toast.install.queued: {title} will be installed after the others
error.installer: The game could not be installed.
error.install.exists: A game with that name is already on the console’s disk.
error.install.windows: Windows games are not ready yet: try again in a moment.
error.install.in_use: Close the game before uninstalling it.
notices.install.ready.detail: It is in the Library: press A on it to play.
notices.install.stopped.detail: The USB disk was removed: plug it in again to install it.
notices.install.space.detail: The console’s disk is full: uninstall a game you no longer play to make room.
notices.install.failed.detail: The installer did not finish: what it had written was removed.
pointer.help.title: The controller as a mouse
pointer.help.text: For windows made for a mouse. It turns off by itself when another window takes the screen.
pointer.help.home: Home: the pointer off, and more
pointer.help.type: Type text (a text field opens it by itself)
pointer.type.title: Type in {app}
error.pointer: The controller cannot act as a mouse right now.
error.pointer.text: The text could not be typed into the window.
controls.pointer.how: Home, then “Resume with the pointer” on the running game. It turns off by itself when another window takes the screen.
first.pair.searching: Searching for controllers. There is nothing to press here.
first.pair.ps: Hold PS and Create until the light bar blinks fast.
first.pair.xbox: Hold the pair button on the top edge until the logo blinks fast.
first.pair.switch: Hold the small sync button on top for 3 seconds.
first.pair.cable.title: USB cable
first.pair.cable: Plug it in. It works right away, no pairing needed.
first.pair.note: The first set-up needs a Bluetooth controller or one with a cable. An Xbox wireless adapter works once its firmware is downloaded, a few steps from now.
first.lang.title: Choose your language
first.lang.text: The keyboard follows the language; you can change both in Settings.
first.net.title: Connect to the internet
first.net.text: For Steam, streaming and updates. Games on disks and DRM-free games work without it.
first.net.later: Not now: set it up later
first.net.no_wifi: No Wi-Fi on this console: connect a cable, or set it up later.
first.time.title: Your time zone
first.time.suggested: Suggested from your language. Once online the clock sets itself; the time zone stays the one you choose.
first.time.chosen: Once online the clock sets itself; the time zone stays the one you choose.
first.time.choose.text: Your language is spoken in several time zones: pick the city nearest to you.
first.time.failed: The time zone could not be set: choose it again in Settings.
first.dongle.title: Xbox wireless adapter found
first.dongle.text: To work, it needs Microsoft’s firmware. OwneetOS downloads it now from Microsoft, for this PC only. By downloading you accept Microsoft’s terms.
first.dongle.done: The Xbox wireless adapter is ready
first.dongle.failed: The firmware could not be downloaded.
first.dongle.failed.offline: The firmware could not be downloaded: the console is not online.
first.ready.title: You are all set
first.ready.text: Your console is ready. Settings has everything you chose here.
first.terms.title: Microsoft’s terms
first.terms.text: Scan the code with your phone to read them.
clock.title: Date and time
clock.text: Without the internet the console uses the PC’s own clock: correct it here if it is wrong. Once online it sets itself again.
clock.failed: The time could not be set.
language.time_zone.detail: Never guessed from where you are
language.time.pc: From the PC’s clock: set it if it is wrong
language.time.auto: Online, the console sets the time by itself
